Subject: Helios4b - brief advisory for Brightline Systems (we're on it)

Maya / Samir —
Quick update from Redwood: we detected an elevated rate of 5xx errors impacting requests routed to the Helios4b model in us-east beginning ~07:55 PDT this morning. We have engineers actively investigating and have applied short-term mitigations (autoscaler increase + optional routing to Helios4b-quant).

What you might have seen: a small fraction of failed generations and occasional timeouts for requests with long contexts; total impacted traffic peaked around 6% of requests for a ~10 minute window. 

What we did immediately:
- Autoscaler increased Helios4b pool capacity; queue shedding thresholds adjusted to reduce tail latency.
- Offered a temporary routing rule to Brightline to shift production traffic to Helios4b-quant; Samir, please reply if you want us to flip this for you now.

Next steps:
- We will continue to monitor for 2 hours and follow up with a short incident summary and an ops ticket link.
- If you notice degraded responses or timeouts, please forward any sample request ids and timestamps to eng@brightline.com and cc me.

ETA for initial follow-up: by 12:00 PDT today.

Apologies for the interruption — we appreciate the flag and will share the post-incident notes once the team completes the initial RCA.

Best,
Marissa Cole
